senses.gloss: m. (נגד) [stretched,] leather bag for wine, milk &c.; which travellers at night stretch like a tent in order to let the cool air strike it, large leather bottle.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 138a:2">Sabb. 138ᵃ</cite> <he>הג׳ … לא יעשה</he> (Ms. M. <he>הנוד</he> a. O., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) one must not stretch the bag &c. on the Sabbath. Ib.ᵇ, v. <cite ref="K00934"><he>כֶּסֶךְ</he></cite>.
